name: Monke Go
summary: Monke Go is a fun game where you use your arms to run and GO! You can go to Forest to swing around or go to Beach for a nice swim! If you get Bored try out our games Modes including only up, rising lava, glass bridge, racing etc.! Go to shop to get a cool look or watch the TV for funny videos! Make friends, have fun, its endless! Play Monke Go now!
